external_entities.name: Customer
external_entities.description: A customer who browses and places orders through the mobile app and receives fax confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: Marketing
external_entities.description: The marketing team that maintains the product catalogue in a spreadsheet.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application customers use to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: Web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app to handle customer and order data.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that receives orders and handles dispatch processing.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS, our stock and inventory system

processes.name: Macros
processes.description: Spreadsheet macros that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

processes.name: Fax gateway
processes.description: A gateway that receives dispatch notes and faxes customer confirmations.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway, which faxes the customer a confirmation
processes.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_stores.name: User database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the user database ... [is] encrypted.

data_stores.name: Flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file kept alongside SIMS containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether ... the flat file [is] encrypted.

data_stores.name: Catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The spreadsheet containing the product catalogue, including prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

data_stores.name: Marketing laptop
data_stores.description: The laptop in the office where the catalogue spreadsheet is stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: A customer browses the catalogue and places an order through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: API requests
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API over HTTP.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS
data_flows.data_description: Mobile app requests to the web API

data_flows.name: keep customers
data_flows.description: The web API keeps customer information in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: Customer name, address, and payment card information

data_flows.name: hand order
data_flows.description: The web API hands an order over to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address to the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
data_flows.data_description: Dispatch note containing customer name and address

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes a confirmation containing the customer's name and address to the customer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_flows.description: Marketing maintains the product catalogue in the spreadsheet.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains customer name, address, and the card they paid with.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file's contents are confidential because it contains delivery addresses.

assumptions.assumption: The marketing team is represented as a human external entity.
